question: This is a topographic map. The contour interval is 20 meters, index contours (heavy lines) are every 100 meters, and elevations are in meters. Wildfire: a fire is burning at the magenta square F and a crew is at the magenta square S. Fire spreads fastest uphill, so the crew is safe only on a route that stays below the elevation of F the whole way. Three escape trails (dashed black lines) leave S: Summit Trail, Cedar Trail and Miners Trail. Exactly one of them never climbs to the elevation of F. Which trail should the crew take? Answer with the trail name, for example Summit Trail.
references: USGS 7.5-minute topographic quadrangle maps (1:24 000, brown contours, bold index contours)
USGS Topographic Map Symbols booklet (contours, spot elevations, trails, streams)
